interview:
I won the game! Here's what happened:

I entered the name "Chonk" and started playing. The cat (Le Chonk) started near the bottom-left of the 7×7 grid, the fish was at the top-right corner, and the guard dog started in the middle.

My strategy was to move the cat **right along the bottom row** (which was completely clear of obstacles) until reaching the rightmost column, then **move straight up** that clear column to reach the fish. The dog chased from behind but always stayed a few squares away.

After 12 moves, the cat reached the fish at the top-right corner. The screen now shows "Le Chonk got the fish! 🐟" with the cat and fish on the same square, and a "Play again" button. The dog never caught the cat — I won!
